_comment: Text for the page that the card data does not provide. Prices for excluded staples were checked on 2026-10-21. price_overrides holds TCGplayer prices for cards that the Pokémon TCG API has no price for yet. They were checked on 2026-10-22 at tcgcsv.com, which copies TCGplayer prices each day. checklist_issue is the number of the GitHub Issue that holds the card checklist.

price_exceptions.pl3-71: Supreme Victors Minun. Kept on purpose for its Call for Family and Trash Charge attacks.

Grass.headline: Meganium · Rillaboom · Sinistcha
Grass.summary: Rillaboom and Eldegoss find Grass Energy every turn. Meganium evolves a Basic straight into a Stage 2 every turn, and Bayleef finds any Evolution card. Sinistcha places 4 damage counters anywhere, or discards Grass Energy for up to 210 damage. Yanmega hits for 160, Celebi devolves an opponent's Pokémon, and Durant mills the opponent's deck.

Fire.headline: Charizard · Cinderace · Arcanine
Fire.summary: Charizard makes each Basic Fire Energy count as two. Growlithe, Volcanion, Cinderace and Arcanine pull Fire Energy from the deck or the discard pile. Salazzle makes the opponent discard up to 3 cards on the turn it evolves.

Water.headline: Inteleon · Baxcalibur · Palafin
Water.summary: Drizzile and Inteleon search out Trainers, Octillery draws, and Baxcalibur attaches Water Energy from your hand as often as you like. Kyogre and Hisuian Basculegion hit harder for each Basic Energy in your discard pile. Palafin hits hardest on the turn it switches in, and Seaking hits any of the opponent's Pokémon for 30 for each Water Energy on it.

Lightning.headline: Eelektross · Magnezone · Electivire
Lightning.summary: Magnezone and Eelektrik accelerate Lightning Energy. Eelektross goes straight from your hand to your Bench when you have 4 Lightning Energy in play, then takes their Energy. Raichu, Electivire and Zapdos hit for 190 to 220. Electrode refills your hand, and Toxtricity hits harder for each type on your Bench.

Psychic.headline: Gallade · Gardevoir · Dusknoir
Psychic.summary: Kirlia evolves into Gardevoir for draw power or into Gallade, which hits for 160 and finds a Supporter every turn. Dusclops, Yamask and Cofagrigus place damage counters, and Dusknoir moves them where they score knockouts.

Fighting.headline: Machamp · Conkeldurr · Garganacl
Fighting.summary: Garganacl heals 20 from each of your Pokémon every turn and hits for 130. Conkeldurr hits for 80 with one Energy and 250 at full power. Claydol draws to six, and Machoke and Donphan make the deck hard to knock out.

Darkness.headline: Obstagoon · Crobat · Mightyena
Darkness.summary: Golbat and Crobat draw cards as they evolve. Mightyena hits for 160 with any Energy. Zigzagoon, Obstagoon and Absol place or move damage counters, and Sableye uses any Supporter in your deck as its attack.

Metal.headline: Metagross · Corviknight · Copperajah
Metal.summary: Metang and Bronzong accelerate Metal Energy, and Archaludon gives every Pokémon with Metal Energy a free retreat. Metagross and Corviknight hit for 200, Archaludon hits for 160, and Copperajah has 200 HP. Klefki stops one of the opponent's attacks for a turn.

Colorless.headline: Pidgeot · Porygon-Z · Blissey
Colorless.summary: Blissey has 200 HP and fully heals a Benched Pokémon, and Miltank heals 90 whenever you attach Energy. Lugia hits for 160 with any Energy. Bunnelby mills the opponent's deck, and Noivern attacks for free when both hands are the same size. Pidgeotto, Porygon2, Cinccino and Dodrio fit any deck.
